answers.core: Design-wise, it's a corollary to the `queue_free` method defined on [Node](https://docs.godotengine.org/en/stable/classes/class_node.html). The signal that a behavior is about to occur should be defined alongside the behavior.
answers.workaround: Given how commonly this is asked about on discord/reddit/Q&A/stackoverflow/etc, I expect it will be used often. Godot doesn't really have a canonical answer for dealing with freed nodes, and `is_instance_valid` is a bandaid.

title: Emit a `freeing` signal when `queue_free` is called on a Node
